decision.notes: Targeted tests pass, but source review found visible behavior gaps in c1. Escalate one tier per workflow.
reasons: Climb starts directly from the viewport floor regardless of the target card bottom or reach. nextAction and the approach-complete transition create climb from state.y=floor to ticket.y, with no jump-to-side phase. A floating card far above the floor therefore makes the mascot climb through empty air, contrary to the ticket's reachable-card-side requirement.

Climb preserves the preceding horizontal travel facing. When approaching the left side from the right (or right side from the left), the sprite faces away from the card. Set facing toward the attachment side and prove it in trajectory tests.

Strengthen climb tests to assert the body/hand reach overlaps a real card side for the full climb phase, and verify approach/jump-to-side/climb/pull-onto-top continuity on a card well above floor. Existing tests endorse floor-to-top climbing without checking actual attachment.
